CGU.title: Terms of Use
CGU.intro: Welcome to Haux Alerte. By using this application, you agree to these terms.

legal.title: 1. LEGAL NOTICES AND PURPOSE
legal.content:
1.1. Service Editor
The Haux Alerte application is edited by the citizen initiative 'HAUX C'EST VOUS', represented by Sophie RICAUD.
Contact: S.RICAUD2026@GMAIL.COM

1.2. Nature of the service (Important Warning)
This application is a private initiative in the context of the 2026 municipal elections.
It is in no way an official service of the Haux City Council.
Reports made on this platform do not trigger immediate technical intervention by current municipal services. They are intended to identify needs for the future municipal program.

1.3. Hosting
The application and data are hosted by:
Vercel Inc. (Infrastructure and Photo Storage)
Neon (Database)

access.title: 2. ACCESS AND REGISTRATION
access.content:
2.1. Authentication
Access to reporting features requires authentication via Google or a Magic Link sent by email. You are responsible for the security of your email access.

2.2. Trust System (User Roles)
To guarantee the quality of information:
- New users ('Newcomer'): You can send reports (type and photo), but adding text descriptions is restricted.
- Confirmed users ('Citizen'): This feature unlocks automatically after validation of several relevant reports by our administrators.

privacy.title: 3. PERSONAL DATA (GDPR)
privacy.content:
In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation, here is how we process your data:

3.1. Collected Data
- Mandatory: Email address (for authentication and follow-up notifications).
- Functional: Geolocation (latitude/longitude) during reporting.
- Content: Photos and descriptions of road issues.
- Technical: Session cookies necessary to maintain your connection.

3.2. Purpose
Your data is used exclusively to:
1. Authenticate your account.
2. Locate incidents on the map.
3. Notify you by email of the progress of your report (Approved/Rejected).

3.3. Your Rights
As the application does not currently offer an automatic deletion feature in the interface, you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, or erasure by contacting: S.RICAUD2026@GMAIL.COM.

moderation.title: 4. OPERATION AND MODERATION
moderation.content:
4.1. 'A Priori' Moderation
Any submitted report is placed in 'PENDING' status. It is not publicly visible on the map until it has been manually validated by an administrator.

4.2. Content Rules and Photos
By publishing a photo, you guarantee that you own the rights or necessary authorization.
Formal Prohibitions:
- Photos allowing identification of people (faces) or vehicles (legible license plates) without prior blurring.
- Insulting, defamatory, or discriminatory remarks.
- Photos relating to private life (interiors of properties, private gardens not visible from the public highway).

Photos are stored on a third-party service (Vercel Blob) publicly accessible via a secure URL for display in the application.

4.3. Rejection Reasons
Administrators reserve the right to reject a report for the following reasons (non-exhaustive list):
- Duplicate: The issue has already been reported.
- Private Property: The issue does not concern the public domain.
- Outside Jurisdiction: The report is located outside the commune of Haux.
- Lack of information: The photo or location is unusable.
- Inappropriate content.

4.4. Sanctions
In case of serious or repeated abuse (spam, insults), administrators may ban your account. A banned user can no longer submit reports.

responsibility.title: 5. LIABILITY
responsibility.content:
5.1. Emergencies
Haux Alerte is not an emergency service.
For any serious and imminent danger (accident, gas leak, electric cable on the ground), immediately contact emergency services (18 or 112) or the Gendarmerie (17).

5.2. Limitation of Liability
The 'HAUX C'EST VOUS' initiative declines all liability:
- In case of technical impossibility to access the service.
- On the accuracy of information provided by users.
- On the processing times or resolution of reported road issues (these falling under current municipal competence).

ip.title: 6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
ip.content:
By submitting a report (text and photo) on Haux Alerte, you grant the 'HAUX C'EST VOUS' initiative a non-exclusive, free, and worldwide license to use, reproduce, and distribute this content for the needs of the project (display on the map, communication on road assessment).

The source code, design, logo, and concept of the application remain the exclusive property of their respective authors.

jurisdiction.title: 7. APPLICABLE LAW AND JURISDICTION
jurisdiction.content: These Terms of Use are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute that cannot be resolved amicably, the competent courts will be those within the jurisdiction of the Court of Appeal of Bordeaux.
